name: anthropic

edits.tradeoff_note: Disables the remote feature-flag fetch itself, not just telemetry, so any capability delivered behind a feature flag silently stops being offered and the client's built-in defaults are what remain. Measured against Claude Code 2.1.241 on 2026-08-24: that build gates /remote-control, /feedback, /design-sync, Projects and --enable-live-preview on this variable. /remote-control stops being offered because its visibility resolves through a flag whose built-in default is off. Upstream anthropics/claude-code#34178 was closed 2026-04-12 without the behaviour changing; it still reproduces. Bisection and re-measurement: https://github.com/lazyants/claude-plugins/issues/142. Users who need any of those capabilities should decline this edit; declining leaves the narrow opt-out, which does not touch the feature-flag fetch. One exception to state when surfacing this: that bundle's DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND disables /feedback by design, so omit it if the user wants that command.

notes: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC is the kill switch but does NOT cover skipWebFetchPreflight.
Prompts/outputs still go to Anthropic's API unless a provider switch is used (changes billing/compute, not just telemetry).

TRADE-OFF (surface to the user before applying): CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC and DISABLE_TELEMETRY each disable the remote feature-flag fetch, not just telemetry, so any Claude Code capability gated by a feature flag silently stops being offered. Measured against Claude Code 2.1.241 on 2026-08-24: that build gates /remote-control, /feedback, /design-sync, Projects and --enable-live-preview on this variable. /remote-control stops being offered because its visibility resolves through a flag whose built-in default is off. Either variable is sufficient on its own: attribution isolated by bisection 2026-04-24, which also settles the question an earlier revision of this note left open. Upstream anthropics/claude-code#34178 was closed 2026-04-12 without the behaviour changing; it still reproduces. Bisection and re-measurement: https://github.com/lazyants/claude-plugins/issues/142. DO_NOT_TRACK and DISABLE_GROWTHBOOK are in the same set and must NOT be shipped as opt-outs for the same reason. If the user needs a capability that disappears, narrow the opt-out: drop these two vars and keep DISABLE_ERROR_REPORTING, DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND and CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY, none of which touch the feature-flag fetch, noting that DISABLE_FEEDBACK_COMMAND does disable /feedback by design, so omit it if the user wants that command.
